version: KORA Index v3 / KORA Methodology v0.1
methodology_note: KORA Index v3 uses a theory-aligned v0.1 pre-empirical calibration. Previous equal weights were provisional scaffolding and are no longer canonical. Confidence Score is external to the KORA Index. Activation Safeguard is an interpretation gate, not a weighted component.

kora_index_v3.cs_note: Confidence Score (CS) is external to the KORA Index v3 computation. Weight = 0 in the KORA Index. CS is displayed in the 10-component breakdown as an external reliability indicator only — it does not influence the KORA Index value.
kora_index_v3.activation_safeguard_note: Activation Safeguard (CLEAR / WARNING / FLAGGED) is an interpretation gate applied after KORA Index computation. It is not a weighted component and does not modify the KORA Index value.
kora_index_v3.note: KORA Index v3 uses a theory-aligned v0.1 pre-empirical calibration. Weights are subject to expert validation and empirical calibration post-pilot.

REACH.label: Activation Reach
REACH.description: Measures whether the company reaches a meaningful share of the workforce. Low reach means most workers are untouched by any verified activation program.

QUALITY.label: Activation Quality
QUALITY.description: Measures whether actions generate deep, verified and additional human activation. Quality distinguishes genuine human impact from surface-level or mandatory compliance events.

EQUITY.label: Distribution & Equity
EQUITY.description: Measures whether activation and value are distributed across workers, sites, departments and clusters. High concentration among few workers or sites reduces equity.

BTI.label: Budget-to-Human-Impact
BTI.description: Measures how effectively people/welfare budget becomes real human value. Computed by the BudgetToHumanImpactEngine from spend classification, activation debt and efficiency metrics — not from KORA Index component values.

legacy_equal_weights_note: Deprecated. Not canonical for KORA Index v3. The previous equal-weight vector (0.10 × 10 components) was provisional scaffolding used in the Foundation Light pre-build phase. It is retained here for backwards compatibility only and must not be used for KORA Index v3 computation or documentation. Use kora_index_v3.macroblocks for v3 computation.
